name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Central Sector Scheme Scholarships
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (एनएसपी) - केंद्रीय क्षेत्र योजना छात्रवृत्तियां
summary: A one-stop platform offering multiple central government scholarships for students from economically weaker sections, SC/ST/OBC, and minority communities from pre-matric to PhD level.
summary_hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों, एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी और अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों के छात्रों के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक से पीएचडी स्तर तक कई केंद्रीय सरकारी छात्रवृत्तियां प्रदान करने वाला एकल मंच।
benefits: Tuition fee coverage for selected schemes
Renewable annually based on academic performance
Direct transfer to student's bank account (DBT)

who_can_apply: Income criteria vary by scheme (typically ₹1-8 lakh/year family income)
who_cannot_apply: Students already receiving another central government scholarship for the same course
Students with less than 50% attendance (for renewal)
Students failing to meet minimum academic percentage criteria
documents_required: Fee receipt / bonafide certificate from institution

eligibility_rules.fail_msg: NSP is for enrolled students only

how_to_apply: Click 'New Registration' and create an account
Log in and fill the Common Application Form (CAF)
Select the scholarship scheme you are eligible for
Upload scanned copies of required documents
Track application status using the application ID
application_process.application_period: Typically July-October each year (varies by scheme)

faq.q: Can I apply for multiple scholarships?
faq.a: You can apply for multiple schemes through NSP, but you will receive only one scholarship for a particular course.

faq.q: What if my application is rejected?
faq.a: Check the rejection reason on the portal. Common reasons: invalid documents, income mismatch, or institution not verified. Correct and reapply.
No. NSP is a free platform. Do not pay anyone to apply.

faq.q: How will I receive the scholarship amount?
faq.a: Directly to your Aadhaar-linked bank account through DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).
